column1: 5.5.4.2.20.20 Show Passive Track History. User shall click on this menu item to view
the all passive tracks details. User has the facility to take print out of the passive track’s
details. User can view the passive tracks by using filter options i.e. (by track no, TOFA,
TOLA, Freq., PW, PRF, DOA and etc). Operator has the facility to select the desired track
parameters for taking printout. History of passive tracks GUI is as shown in Figure-5.215.
